title: Biallelic variants in PIKFYVE cause a hypomyelinating leukodystrophy with endolysosomal dysfunction
title_zh: PIKFYVE 的双等位基因变异导致低髓鞘白质营养不良伴内吞溶酶体功能障碍
abstract: Abstract The PIKfyve-FIG4-VAC14 lipid kinase complex generates phosphoinositide PI(3,5)P2. Pathogenic variants in VAC14 and FIG4 cause neurodevelopmental disorders and PIKFYVE has been linked to autosomal dominant fleck corneal dystrophy. We searched for the underlyging, genetic cause of a neurodevelopmental disorder in five affected individuals from three families using exome- or genome sequencing. Cranial MRI images and clinical phenotypes were analyzed. Size, number and acidity of cellular vacuoles were investigated in patient-derived fibroblasts from family 1 using LysoSensor acidophilic probes. Levels of PI(3,5)P2 were quantified in patient-derived fibroblasts from family 1 using high-performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry. Pikfyve-mutant zebrafish larvae were injected with wildtype-mRNA or mutant mRNA harboring the PIKFYVE missense variant identified in family 3. Pikfyve-mutant zebrafish larvae were treated with metformin, bafilomycin A1, or rapamycin. We identified biallelic PIKFYVE variants in five affected individuals with hypomyelinating leukodystrophy, brain hyperintensities of inferior olives, thalami, long tracts, and optic nerves. Clinically, they presented with intellectual disability, spasticity, muscular weakness, and nystagmus. Additional features included feeding difficulties, auditory dysfunction, insulin resistance, microcephaly, peripheral neuropathy, and mild creatine kinase elevations. We detected four distinct PIKFYVE variants: three loss-of-function variants (family 1 & 2), and one p.Arg1156Pro missense variant (family 3). The pathogenicity of the p.Arg1156Pro variant was confirmed by phenotypic rescue of pikfyve-mutant zebrafish larvae injected with wildtype-mRNA but not with p.Arg1156Pro mRNA. Consistent with the role of PIKfyve in maintaining endolysosomal homeostasis, patient-derived fibroblasts of family 1 accumulated enlarged, hyperacidic vacuoles and showed a reduced PI(3,5)P2 production upon hyperosmotic stimulation. Exposing pikfyve-mutant zebrafisch larvae to the mTORC1 inhibitor and TRPML1 activator rapamycin attenuated cellular vacuolization, highlighting potential therapeutic approaches. Our findings establish PIKFYVE deficiency as a novel cause of hypomyelinating leukodystrophy and endolysosomal dysfunction.
abstract_zh: 摘要 PIKfyve-FIG4-VAC14 脂质激酶复合物生成磷脂酰肌醇 PI(3,5)P2。VAC14 和 FIG4 的致病变异可导致神经发育障碍，PIKFYVE 已与常染色体显性斑点角膜变性相关。我们利用外显子或基因组测序，寻找三大家族中五名受影响个体的神经发育障碍的遗传原因。对颅脑 MRI 图像和临床表型进行分析。使用 LysoSensor 酸性探针研究第一大家族来源的患者成纤维细胞的细胞空泡大小、数量和酸度。利用高效液相色谱-串联质谱定量第一大家族来源的患者成纤维细胞中 PI(3,5)P2 的水平。将野生型 mRNA 或携带第三大家族发现的 PIKFYVE 错义变异的突变 mRNA 注射到 Pikfyve 突变斑马鱼幼虫中。对 Pikfyve 突变斑马鱼幼虫进行二甲双胍、bafilomycin A1 或雷帕霉素处理。我们在五名患有低髓鞘白质营养不良、脑部下橄榄核、丘脑、长束和视神经高信号的个体中鉴定出双等位基因 PIKFYVE 变异。临床表现包括智力障碍、痉挛、肌无力和眼震颤。其他特征包括进食困难、听觉功能障碍、胰岛素抵抗、微头畸形、周围神经病变和轻度肌酸激酶升高。我们检测到四种不同的 PIKFYVE 变异：三种失活变异（第一、二大家族）和一种 p.Arg1156Pro 错义变异（第三大家族）。通过将野生型 mRNA 注射到 Pikfyve 突变斑马鱼幼虫中并观察表型恢复，而 p.Arg1156Pro mRNA 无效，确认了该变异的致病性。与 PIKfyve 在维持内吞溶酶体稳态中的作用一致，第一大家族来源的患者成纤维细胞积累了增大、超酸性空泡，并在高渗刺激下 PI(3,5)P2 产生减少。将 Pikfyve 突变斑马鱼幼虫暴露于 mTORC1 抑制剂和 TRPML1 激活剂雷帕霉素可减轻细胞空泡化，提示潜在的治疗方法。我们的研究确立了 PIKFYVE 缺乏症为低髓鞘白质营养不良和内吞溶酶体功能障碍的新致病原因。
